meta.name: agency-dashboard
meta.description: Generate a portfolio-level dashboard across ALL client brands — per-client RAG health scores, campaign activity, budget pacing, aggregate KPIs, team utilization, pending approvals, upcoming deadlines, and an alerts panel — built for agency standups and weekly reviews. Triggers on "/digital-marketing-pro:agency-dashboard", "how are all our clients doing", "portfolio health check", "budget pacing across accounts", "which accounts are at risk". Enumerates every brand under ~/.claude-marketing/brands/ and pulls data via campaign-tracker.py, execution-tracker.py, and team-manager.py; drill into a single client with /digital-marketing-pro:performance-report or /digital-marketing-pro:client-report.
